Utterance: I'm going to ask you some questions about your developmental history. What city and state were you born and raised in?
Wilmington, Delaware.
Do you speak any other languages other than English?
Spanish, pretty well.
Can you tell me who raised you and if anyone else lived with you?
My biological parents raised me. My grandmother lived with us for a little while during middle and high school, but that was it.
Can you tell me briefly what your life was like growing up?

It was a pretty normal childhood, but my mother was a very angry person, especially towards me. I have two sisters and we didn't want for anything, but I definitely felt like I got the most of her anger compared to my sisters and father.

I've been wondering lately if that's connected to issues I'm having with women at work and in my neighborhood. I wasn't severely abused, but I was hit more than my sisters. My middle sister was seen as perfect, always getting good grades and doing exactly what my parents wanted.
Has that family dynamic changed at all?
I don't think so.
At what age did you move out of your home?
I moved out for college when I was around 19.
How were you disciplined as a child?
Mostly yelling. My mother would also hit my face or pull my hair. It happened less as I got older and could push her away.
How was your father during this time?
He was quiet and didn't really get involved in the discipline.
Let's move on to relationship history. You are married; have you been married before?
No, this is my first marriage.
What is your sexual orientation, and what age were you when you married?
I am heterosexual. I got married when I was 27.
Can you describe your marriage? Does your spouse know you are seeking counseling?
It is a happy marriage. He gets concerned when I have sad periods, and seeking counseling was actually his idea. He's very supportive.
Would he be willing to come in for a session if appropriate?
Definitely.
Does he have any history of substance use, gambling, or mental health concerns?
No, nothing like that. We have been married for 15 years.
Tell me about your previous relationships before marriage.
I had a serious boyfriend in graduate school, and I dated a few people in college and high school.
Do you have any children?
Yes, a 12-year-old son and a 10-year-old daughter. They live with us and I see them every day.
Are there any health or mental health concerns regarding your children?
No, and we've never been involved with Child Protective Services or suffered a traumatic loss.
Can you describe your relationship with your children?
It's a good relationship. I made a point not to be like my mother, so I don't yell at them. We spend a lot of time together as a family and they do well in school.
Do you see any of the patterns from your mother playing out between you and your daughter?
Not really, because I try so hard. I feel myself flare up sometimes, but I don't think it's the same.
Is there anything else I should know about your children?
A few years ago, my son's teacher was worried he might be depressed. We took him to see someone, and he is doing okay now.
I'm going to switch gears again. Are you comfortable moving forward?
Yes.
